title: jcdc-portrait
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of 自由が丘クリニック ドクターズコスメティクス 採用, https://jcdc.co.jp/recruit/01/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 大きな人物肖像、淡い背景と細い格子、縦方向の文字配置。人物の表情を主役にする。
Direction: Use the JCDC recruitment screenshot only as a VISUAL portrait/grid/vertical-type reference, not beauty-industry content. One large original Japanese female call-center operator portrait CENTER, lightweight headset boom mic visible, holding a call-script clipboard, candid warm attentive smile. Pale powder-blue background with a very fine white grid and gentle white margins. Place the two-line headline as elegant vertical Japanese columns on the LEFT and the short subcopy horizontally near bottom-left. Large portrait prominence and dark navy refined serif typography, recruitment editorial mood. No beauty/cosmetic products, source model identity, salary claims or copied source lettering.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "声を届ける、" / "あなたが主役。"; subcopy "電話の向こうに、価値を届ける。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.

attached_images.role: Actual website screenshot; composition/type hierarchy reference

source_site.name: 自由が丘クリニック ドクターズコスメティクス 採用

visual_inspection.headline: Exact approved Japanese headline complete/readable in two vertical columns, right to left reading order
visual_inspection.subcopy: Exact approved subcopy complete/readable horizontally at lower left
